CustomField.description: Copied from Lead.First_Seen_Date__c at Conversion 1 by LeadConvertService.applyDealFields - drives the 90-day broker protection window (see BP_Expiry__c and the Broker_First_Seen_Is_System_Set validation rule). Changed Date -> DateTime 2026-08-30 (WS2) to match the source Lead field, which is DateTime despite its Date-suffixed name. As of this change this description is finally accurate: previously no application code wrote this field, only seed scripts backdated it.
CustomField.label: Broker First Seen
